text:
maria: Heads-up — ran a quick perf sweep on +seqlen=512 with the new kernel selector changes. Seeing a spike in 95p tail and KV cache eviction chatter. Attaching short logs and a flamegraph link.

ton://tony: Can you paste the device_probe output and the kernel decision trace?

maria: Sure — here's the probe + profiler summary from bench-bot: 
```
bench-bot: device_probe: sm=90, compute_cap=90, tensor_cores=true, bf16=true, fp8=false
bench-bot: memory: 41GB free, nvlink peers ok
bench-bot: runtime_autotune: seq=512 batch=1 -> chosen_kernel=matmul_tc_bf16_fastpath
bench-bot: kvcache: live_items=38k, prefetch_hits=0.62, evictions/sec=120
bench-bot: profile_summary: p50=11ms p95=48ms p99=72ms (baseline seqlen=256 p95=39ms)
```

cheng: Wait fp8=false? Should be true on recent H100 images — why is fp8 disabled in probe?

henry: I saw that too earlier — driver 535.x had an env flag that suppressed fp8 detection in our probe. Might be the host image on the canary fleet.

maria: If fp8 is disabled we fall back from the optimized fp8 matmul path to the bf16 fallback, which changes memory usage and KV prefetch behavior. That could explain the eviction spike.

nora: Repro command I'm about to run: `./runtime --model redwood/13b --seq-len 512 --batch 1 --profile --device=h100-1 --kv-prefetch=auto`

tony: Two quick heuristic ideas: 1) don't pick TC fastpath for seqlen=512 when kv_prefetch>0.6 unless fp8 confirmed; 2) add a cheap nvml-derived metric to autotune (gpu_free_after_kvcache) to avoid oversubscription.

cheng: Agreed on metric. Also our sm-version classifier emits `sm_major` but we don't currently gate on micro-arch quirks (e.g., sm90 vs sm91 fp8 enablement). We should add a small capability table: {sm:90 -> fp8_maybe, sm:91 -> fp8_yes}.

maria: I can push a temporary kernel routing override so we run the BF16 path deterministically on the canary pool: `env RW_KERNEL_ROUTE=force:matmul_bf16_generic` — want me to flip?

henry: Do it for 5 nodes. Also increase kv cache watermark: `kv_cache_watermark=0.8` for that canary to reduce prefetch aggressiveness.

nora: Running canary now. I'll report a condensed perf diff in ~20m.

ops-bot: CI canary job #4728 started: https://ci.redwood/4728 — includes kernel_override and kv_watermark changes.

maria: If canary looks stable, next steps for autotune: (a) add small nvml memory-pressure input to kernel-score; (b) widen fp8 detection matrix to include driver/runtime combos; (c) change seq-length gating to use measured kv_pressure instead of static thresholds.

tony: One caution: changing score weights might flip many models to the generic path and bump p50 for small seqs. We should add a regression eval job focused on seqlen=64/128/512 to catch regressions.

cheng: I'll add a unit test for the sm->capability table and a small simulation harness for kernel scores.

maria: Thanks — if canary passes I'll open a PR with the nvml metric and the new capability mapping.

nora: Canary results: p95 down from 48ms->35ms on the 5-node sample after forcing bf16_generic + kv_watermark 0.8. Evictions dropped to ~8/sec. No obvious regression on seqlen=64 in quick smoke.

maria: Great. I'll proceed with a staged rollout + metric to autotune.

henry: Filing followup to track: add debug logging for kernel_score reason and kv_pressure metric to logs.

maria: Filed: https://jira.redwood/browse/RINF-8912 — assign eng-runtime.

tony: Nice work. :thumbsup:
